serverInfo.description: Metered coordination workspace for autonomous agent swarms — locks, budgeted sub-keys, shared file storage, messaging, webhooks, and an activity log. Billed per operation from a prepaid balance funded in USDC via x402 (Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche or Solana). Start with aanet_create_trial_workspace to try every tool for free before funding a real workspace with aanet_deposit.
